applicant_count: Be one of the first 20 applicants
job_description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
WOO TECH Vietnam is the technical innovation hub of the Australia-based WOO Group, specialising in creative and technology solutions. As we transform into an AI-first company, our Vietnam team leads cutting-edge development for global clients ranging from startups to enterprise organisations.

We're building the future of creative technology, combining artificial intelligence, advanced development frameworks, and strategic business analysis to deliver unprecedented value to our clients.

ROLE OVERVIEW
We are seeking an experienced Head of Technology to take ownership of our backend platform and AI-driven product delivery. This is a senior, genuinely hands-on leadership role: expect to split your time roughly evenly between hands-on technical work - architecture, coding, code review, and building AI-powered features yourself - and people and delivery leadership.
You will design and own the engineering system end-to-end, write and review code alongside the team, lead delivery of LLM-powered features, and work closely with leadership to align technology execution with business and GTM objectives.
This is a fast-paced, client-facing environment where priorities can shift quickly. We're looking for someone hard-working who is comfortable with ambiguity, leads from the front, and is willing to jump in and help wherever the team needs it - not someone who only delegates and reports.
This position reports to the CEO, Woo Group, and works closely with our Melbourne team and international clients.

Main Responsibilities
Hands-On Technical Leadership & Architecture
•	Spend approximately half your working time hands-on in the codebase — architecture, coding, and code review — with particular focus on priority and AI-driven features.
•	Hold final accountability for technical decisions, architecture direction and code quality across the Vietnam development team. Own architecture across the backend, and set direction for the frontend at an architectural level.
•	Design for scalability, high availability and sensible failure behaviour — and be able to explain the trade-offs you chose and why.
•	Set and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, technical processes and review practices — across backend and frontend, working through and alongside the Tech Lead. Review the frontend team's code and hold the quality line there, even though you are not writing most of it.
•	Own security practice: authentication and authorisation, secrets handling, dependency and supply-chain risk, and data protection appropriate to our clients' obligations.
•	Evaluate new technologies, frameworks and tools, and decide what the team adopts.
•	Resolve technical escalations — including stepping in to code a fix personally when it's the fastest path to resolution.
•	Own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, deployment and observability.
•	Own production. You are the person who gets the backend working again when it breaks.
•	Own technical risk. Identify technical debt, security risk or delivery risk early, quantify it, and act on it — not just report it, but put it in front of the CEO with an option and a recommendation.
Delivery & Operations Oversight
•	Own delivery performance across all active projects: timelines, quality, resourcing and client-facing technical commitments.
•	Manage workload and resourcing across the team, including prioritisation when capacity is under pressure.
•	Run the operational rhythm of the team: standups, sprint planning, reporting cadence.
•	Identify and remove delivery bottlenecks before they become client-facing problems.
•	Report delivery status, risks and resourcing needs directly to the CEO, with a clear view and a recommendation, not just a status update.
Team Leadership & Development
•	Hold direct leadership accountability for the full Vietnam technical team: developers, Business Analysis and QA/Testing.
•	Manage the Development team directly, including performance, development and workload.
•	Build the capability of the wider team, including BA and QA: mentoring, career development, and identifying who is ready for more responsibility.
•	Own hiring input and onboarding for engineering roles in Vietnam.
•	Handle performance issues directly and early. Escalate to the CEO only when needed, with the issue already worked through.
•	Build a team that runs well without the CEO's day-to-day involvement.
AI Adoption & Implementation
•	Own the practical rollout of AI tools and AI-assisted workflows across the engineering team, from code generation through to testing and documentation.
•	Identify where AI can reduce delivery time or cost on client work, and put it into production, not just pilot it.
•	Set the expectation and baseline that AI-assisted tools are part of how the team works day to day, not an optional extra.
•	Track and report the impact of AI adoption on delivery speed, cost and quality.
•	Keep the team current on relevant AI development tools and bring forward what's worth adopting.
Stakeholder & Client Coordination
•	Act as the senior technical point of contact for client-facing delivery issues escalated from the team.
•	Work with Account Management and Melbourne leadership to align technical delivery with client commitments.
•	Flag commercial or scope risk arising from technical delivery early, before it becomes a client issue.
Documentation & Reporting
•	Maintain visibility of team capacity, delivery status and technical risk in a form the CEO can act on quickly.
•	Ensure technical documentation, deployment guides and handover material are maintained to a consistent standard across the team.
•	Oversee timesheet management to support delivery tracking, resource planning, and operational reporting.
•	Provide a regular, structured report to the CEO covering delivery status, team performance, risks and AI adoption progress.
job_requirements:

•	Strong expertise in backend system design, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.

job_description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
Lê & Trần is a leading Vietnamese litigation and arbitration firm. We are looking for an in-house IT Officer to take full ownership of the firm's technology environment — from day-to-day user support and network administration to information security and the deployment of AI-assisted legal tools. This is a hands-on role in an environment where system reliability and client confidentiality are non-negotiable.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Infrastructure & equipment
• Install, maintain and manage all workstations, laptops, docking stations, printers/scanners and network hardware across the firm.
• Administer the LAN/Wi-Fi network, routers, firewalls and internet connectivity; ensure business continuity for the firm's operations.
• Maintain the IT asset register, plan hardware refresh cycles and prepare the annual technology budget.
2. Systems & account administration
• Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams): account provisioning and deprovisioning, permissions, security policies and MFA.
• Administer the firm's document and matter management systems and internal workflow software.
• Design and operate backup and disaster recovery procedures, including regular restore testing.
3. Information security & client confidentiality
• Implement information security policies appropriate to the confidentiality obligations of a law practice.
• Manage endpoint protection, anti-malware and email phishing defences; monitor for anomalous access.
• Support compliance with Vietnamese personal data protection requirements (Decree 13/2023/ND-CP).
• Deliver periodic security awareness training to lawyers and staff.
4. User support & AI tooling
• Provide day-to-day technical support to lawyers and administrative staff, both on-site and remotely.
• Deploy, configure and administer the AI platforms used by the firm, and coach users on getting value from them.
• Ensure that use of AI tools remains consistent with the firm's confidentiality and data handling policies.
• Provide technical support for online hearings, virtual mediation and arbitration sessions, client meetings, seminars and firm events.
job_requirements:
Essential
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security or a related discipline.
• Minimum 3 years' experience in an IT support or IT administrator role; experience in a law firm, audit firm, consultancy or other professional services environment is strongly preferred.
• Strong working knowledge of Windows administration, Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD) and enterprise networking.
• Sound understanding of information security principles and personal data protection.
• Good English reading comprehension for technical documentation; working conversational English.
Preferred
• Certifications such as MS-102, CCNA, CompTIA Security+ or equivalent.
• Experience deploying AI or automation tools in a business environment.
• Scripting ability (PowerShell, Python) for administrative automation.
• Experience working in a high-confidentiality environment.
Personal attributes
• Discretion and a strong instinct for confidentiality — this is a threshold requirement in a legal practice.
• Proactive, resourceful and calm under pressure when systems fail during working hours.
• Patient and clear when supporting non-technical users.

WHAT WE OFFER
• Competitive salary, negotiable based on experience and capability.
• Performance and firm-results based bonuses.
• Full social, health and unemployment insurance in accordance with Vietnamese law.
• Direct exposure to leading technology and AI platforms in a professional legal setting.
• A professional working environment at one of Vietnam's leading litigation firms.

applicant_count: 20 applicants
job_description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of AI products used by Virtuos employees. These may include AI assistants, knowledge search, content generation tools, and automated workflows that support creative, development, and business teams.

You will lead testing from early prototypes through release and ongoing use. Working with R&D engineers, product managers, and internal users, you will assess both software behavior and AI output quality. You will build automated checks, investigate user issues, and mentor junior QA engineers.

•	Define test strategies, plans, and release criteria for internal AI products. Prioritize coverage based on user impact, data sensitivity, and product risk.
•	Test complete user workflows across web, cloud, and desktop applications, as applicable. Verify APIs, integrations, access permissions, and failure recovery.
•	Build and maintain evaluation datasets from approved internal use cases. Agree clear scoring criteria with product owners and subject experts for accuracy, relevance, completeness, and task success.
•	Evaluate AI outputs through repeatable tests and human review. Cover incorrect or unsupported answers, inconsistent results, ambiguous requests, and unusual inputs.
•	For AI knowledge search, verify source accuracy, answer references, and access restrictions. For AI agents, test tool use, approval steps, and protection against unintended actions.
•	Test safeguards for confidential company and client information. Cover unauthorized access, data leakage, and attempts to make the AI ignore instructions or reveal restricted content.
•	Build automated functional, API, regression, and AI evaluation tests. Add reliable checks to continuous integration and delivery pipelines and compare results after model, prompt, data, or code changes.
•	Assess response times, concurrent usage, service limits, and cost per task. Verify timeouts, retries, fallback behavior, and clear error messages when AI services fail.
•	Coordinate pilot testing and user acceptance testing with internal teams. Turn employee feedback and production issues into test cases and improvements.
•	Investigate defects with engineers. Capture relevant inputs, model and prompt versions, logs, and steps to reproduce issues while protecting sensitive data.
•	Report test coverage, AI quality trends, and release risks. Recommend release readiness, verify fixes, and track recurring quality issues after launch.
•	Mentor junior QA engineers and improve shared testing methods, documentation, and automation practices.
job_requirements:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
•	5+ years of QA experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead capacity.
•	Strong experience testing cloud applications, APIs, and software integrations. Familiarity with desktop application testing.
•	Hands-on experience testing AI-enabled applications, including products using large language models. Ability to assess outputs that can vary between runs and define practical quality measures.
•	Proficiency in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript for test automation. Experience with tools such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, and frameworks such as pytest or Jest.
•	Experience adding automated tests to CI/CD pipelines, such as GitLab CI. Working knowledge of Git, REST API testing, authentication, and role-based access control.
•	Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Ability to explain quality risks clearly, work with internal users, and lead testing across teams.
•	Ability to mentor QA colleagues and take ownership of quality through release and ongoing product use.

Preferred Qualifications
•	Experience evaluating AI search grounded in company documents, AI agents, or generated text, images, and code.
•	Familiarity with AI evaluation tools, performance testing, production monitoring, and secure handling of internal test data.
•	Experience supporting internal enterprise tools or workflows in game development, game art, or production.

- Leading or contributing to technical initiatives in the internal cloud infrastructure through experience from customer projects.

job_description:
1. Mục tiêu vị trí:
Thực hiện các hoạt động bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân trong phạm vi SSI, bảo đảm việc thu thập, sử dụng, lưu trữ, chia sẻ, chuyển giao và xóa/hủy dữ liệu cá nhân được nhận diện, đánh giá rủi ro và kiểm soát theo quy định pháp luật, quy định nội bộ và mục đích xử lý đã được phê duyệt.
Tư vấn và phối hợp với Luật & Kiểm soát tuân thủ, An ninh thông tin, Công nghệ thông tin, Chủ sở hữu dữ liệu, Chủ sở hữu hệ thống và các đơn vị nghiệp vụ để áp dụng Privacy by Design, Privacy by Default và Data Minimization vào quy trình, dự án và hệ thống.
Vị trí tập trung vào thực thi, phân tích, giám sát và lưu bằng chứng; không thay thế thẩm quyền pháp lý, thẩm quyền phê duyệt nghiệp vụ hoặc trách nhiệm của Chủ sở hữu dữ liệu.

2. Trách nhiệm chính:
A. Chính sách, quy trình và kiểm soát bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân
- Tham gia xây dựng, cập nhật và triển khai chính sách, quy định, quy trình, hướng dẫn, checklist và biểu mẫu.
- Theo dõi thay đổi yêu cầu pháp luật và nội bộ; hỗ trợ phân tích khoảng cách và đề xuất cập nhật kiểm soát.
- Duy trì danh mục nghĩa vụ, đầu việc, bằng chứng và tình trạng khắc phục trong phạm vi được phân công.
B. Đánh giá tác động và quản lý hồ sơ
- Thu thập thông tin, phân tích data flow, xác định mục đích, loại dữ liệu, chủ thể dữ liệu, bên tham gia và hệ thống liên quan.
- Lập, rà soát và cập nhật hồ sơ đánh giá tác động xử lý dữ liệu cá nhân; phối hợp lập hồ sơ đánh giá tác động chuyển dữ liệu cá nhân xuyên biên giới khi phát sinh.
- Đề xuất biện pháp giảm thiểu, theo dõi điều kiện phê duyệt, hành động khắc phục, phiên bản và bằng chứng.
C. Privacy by Design cho dự án, hệ thống và AI
- Tham gia rà soát dự án, sản phẩm, quy trình, hệ thống, Data Platform, phân tích dữ liệu và AI có xử lý dữ liệu cá nhân.
- Đánh giá sự phù hợp của mục đích, phạm vi thu thập, thời hạn lưu trữ, chia sẻ, truy cập và sử dụng thứ cấp.
- Phối hợp đề xuất phân loại, masking, pseudonymization, de-identification, anonymization, mã hóa, phân quyền, logging và monitoring.
- Ghi nhận kết quả privacy review, điều kiện triển khai, rủi ro tồn dư và trường hợp cần trình ngoại lệ.
D. Quyền của chủ thể dữ liệu và vòng đời dữ liệu
- Tiếp nhận, xác minh, phân loại, điều phối và theo dõi yêu cầu thực hiện quyền của chủ thể dữ liệu.
- Phối hợp xử lý yêu cầu truy cập, chỉnh sửa, cung cấp, xóa, hạn chế hoặc phản đối xử lý và rút lại sự đồng ý theo quy định áp dụng.
- Theo dõi thời hạn, chất lượng phản hồi, bằng chứng hoàn thành, lịch lưu trữ và yêu cầu xóa/hủy dữ liệu.
E. Bên thứ ba và chuyển giao dữ liệu
- Thực hiện đánh giá rủi ro đối với nhà cung cấp, đối tác, bên xử lý, bên thứ ba và dịch vụ cloud có liên quan.
- Phối hợp rà soát điều khoản bảo vệ dữ liệu, bảo mật, thông báo sự cố, xóa/trả dữ liệu và quyền kiểm tra.
- Duy trì danh mục bên liên quan, luồng chia sẻ/chuyển giao, kết quả đánh giá và hành động khắc phục.
F. Giám sát tuân thủ, sự cố và báo cáo
- Thực hiện đánh giá định kỳ hoặc theo chuyên đề; ghi nhận phát hiện, mức độ rủi ro, chủ sở hữu và thời hạn khắc phục.
- Phối hợp xử lý dấu hiệu vi phạm hoặc sự cố dữ liệu cá nhân; hỗ trợ xác định phạm vi, loại dữ liệu, chủ thể bị ảnh hưởng và biện pháp giảm thiểu.
- Chuẩn bị hồ sơ, bằng chứng và báo cáo phục vụ quản lý, kiểm tra, kiểm toán hoặc cơ quan có thẩm quyền theo phân công.
- Theo dõi KPI/KRI và đề xuất cải tiến hoạt động bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân.
G. Đào tạo và tư vấn
- Soạn tài liệu đào tạo, FAQ, tình huống mẫu và hướng dẫn thực hành theo vai trò.
- Hỗ trợ đào tạo, truyền thông và tư vấn cho đơn vị nghiệp vụ, dự án và kỹ thuật.
- Hướng dẫn đơn vị chuẩn bị data flow, hồ sơ, bằng chứng và kế hoạch khắc phục.

job_description:

JOB PURPOSE
Define GBIA's eCommerce go-to-market strategy within the Customer Experience programme and drive its execution once approved. The role turns market opportunity into a prioritised, commercially validated eCommerce model spanning proposition, fulfilment and technology, then into an investable business case and delivery roadmap that secures GBIA's direct guest relationship across passenger and non-passenger areas.
We welcome senior candidates from both Tech-heavy and Business/Commercial backgrounds.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Opportunity sizing & commercial model
▪ Validate the $/O&D-pax benchmark; size demand by category (DF, luxury, F&B) and arena (A1/A2/A3); prioritise categories and arenas for phase 1
▪ Confirm the in-house marketplace model and map ownership across the value chain; define eCommerce commercial arrangements with DF-operator, retailers and F&Bs - set the revenue/margin model and single-platform rights
▪ Deliverables: sized opportunity and prioritised roadmap; operating model and DF engagement framework

Proposition, fulfilment & technology design
▪ Define the CVP by segment and embed eCommerce into the E2E guest journey; detail use cases (departure gift, arrival pickup, gate F&B); specify pre-order windows, loyalty and CTAs
▪ Design the fulfilment model (pickup points, dark store, gate delivery, after-sales); set SLAs and operator responsibilities; address A3 cross-border / FEZ conditions
Define platform scope (build vs buy, marketplace capabilities); specify the guest data platform, integration, auth and consent; map data exchange with the ecosystem and partners
▪ Deliverables: CVP and use-case blueprints; fulfilment and SLA framework; target architecture and build/buy recommendation

Business case, roadmap & execution
▪ Consolidate the financial model (investment, revenue, phasing); produce the GTM roadmap, org/resourcing and governance; prepare execution kickoff on approval
▪ Deliverables: business case, roadmap and execution plan

• Hands-on with market sizing, financial modelling, operating-model design and build-vs-buy evaluation
• Exposure to guest data platforms, digital journeys and loyalty is a strong plus
• Advanced analytics & data storytelling (Excel/BI, PowerPoint)

FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES

• Commercial & operating-model design
• Financial modelling & business-case development
• Customer proposition & journey design
• eCommerce/marketplace & fulfilment operations
• Technology & data-platform assessment (build vs buy)
• Stakeholder management & vendor negotiation

job_description:
MỤC ĐÍCH CÔNG VIỆC/ JOB PURPOSE
Act as the technical control point between the Design Consultant and the Installation Contractor(s) for ICT systems, ensuring what gets installed matches what was designed — and that both parties deliver against schedule, scope, and standard. This role does not design or install systems; it verifies, controls, coordinates, and manages the interface between those who do. Responsible for catching gaps, conflicts, and non-conformances before they become costly rework, and for keeping the ICT Director informed with accurate technical status.

TRÁCH NHIỆM CHÍNH/ KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
• Review and verify designer-issued IFC drawings, cable schedules, rack elevations, and BoQs for completeness and internal consistency before release to the installer
• Confirm installer's work-in-progress matches issued design; flag deviations, omissions, or field conditions that require designer clarification or formal design change
• Act as the formal channel for RFIs (Requests for Information) between installer and designer — logging, tracking, and closing them within schedule targets
• Monitor installer compliance with approved designs, project specifications, and relevant standards (TIA/ISO, BICSI, IATA/ICAO where applicable) — without personally performing installation
• Witness or audit inspection/test hold points (containment, cabling, termination, rack build) carried out by installer
• Review installer-submitted test results (OTDR, copper certification, system test reports) for compliance against design pass/fail criteria; reject and require re-test where results are inadequate
• Track installer progress against the ICT schedule; identify slippage risk and escalate with technical justification
• Review and endorse (or reject) installer technical submittals, method statements, and material submittals before designer/client approval
• Coordinate factory acceptance testing (FAT) and site acceptance testing (SAT) logistics between vendor, designer, and installer, attending as the client/PM-side technical representative
• Assess technical impact of site-driven variations or installer-proposed deviations, and route them through the designer for formal resolution
• Maintain a technical issues/risk log specific to ICT systems, feeding into the Delivery Manager's overall risk register
• Prevent scope/interpretation gaps between design intent and installed reality by maintaining a single source of technical truth (drawing register, RFI log, NCR log)
• Coordinate (not execute) integrated systems testing (IST) between installer, designer, and other disciplines (BHS, security, BMS)
• Verify commissioning documentation and test packs are complete, correctly signed off, and traceable before accepting handover from installer
• Confirm as-built drawings from the designer/installer accurately reflect the final installed condition
• Produce technical status reports for the ICT Director: RFI/NCR status, test pass/fail rates, submittal turnaround, schedule risk
• Represent ICT technical status in site coordination meetings
job_requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in ICT infrastructure projects, with meaningful time spent in a client-side, PMC, or technical control/QA role (not purely design or purely installation)
• Strong working knowledge of structured cabling, network infrastructure, and airport-specific ICT systems (SCS, CCTV, access control, PA/VA, FIDS) — enough to critically review, not to design from scratch
• Experience managing RFI, NCR, and submittal review processes on capital projects
• Familiarity with TIA/ISO/BICSI cabling standards and relevant test/commissioning protocols
• Comfortable reading and cross-checking drawings, BoQs, and test reports without authoring them
• Fluent English is a must

A. Chính sách, quy trình và kiểm soát bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân
- Tham gia xây dựng, cập nhật và triển khai chính sách, quy định, quy trình, hướng dẫn, checklist và biểu mẫu.

C. Privacy by Design cho dự án, hệ thống và AI

- Thực hiện đánh giá rủi ro đối với nhà cung cấp, đối tác, bên xử lý, bên thứ ba và dịch vụ cloud có liên quan.

- Duy trì danh mục bên liên quan, luồng chia sẻ/chuyển giao, kết quả đánh giá và hành động khắc phục.
F. Giám sát tuân thủ, sự cố và báo cáo

- Theo dõi KPI/KRI và đề xuất cải tiến hoạt động bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân.

job_description:
The Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Salesforce Developer to build the platform capability behind Keyloop’s AI agents. This is a hands-on engineering role in which Salesforce Agentforce is the starting point for almost everything you will work on.

It is important to be clear about how the work arrives. Requirements here begin with an agent capability – a new process Kara should handle, a task an internal agent should take on, an interaction that should no longer need a person. Your job is to make that real on the platform: designing the data model it needs, building the Flows, Apex and Lightning Web Components the agent will invoke, wiring in the integrations that give it access to the right systems and data, and proving it behaves correctly. The Salesforce engineering is substantial and it is genuinely yours – but it is driven by what the agents need to do, rather than sitting separately from it.

You do not need prior Agentforce experience. We are looking for strong Salesforce engineering fundamentals – that is the part that takes years to build. Agentforce is something we will teach you, with instructor-led training and time to learn. What we do ask is that you find this kind of work interesting, because it is what the team does every day.
The role sits within the Customer Enablement (CE) organisation, part of Keyloop’s growing Global Delivery Hub in Vietnam. You will own solutions end to end, from requirement through to production, and work directly with the people who use what you build.

Building for AI Agents
•	Translate agent capabilities into platform design – taking a new or expanded Agentforce use case and determining the objects, fields, automation, code and integrations required to support it.
•	Build the actions our agents invoke, using Flows, Apex and Lightning Web Components, so that Kara and our internal agents can execute real work rather than only answer questions.
•	Make the right data available to agents at the right moment, through sound data modelling and reliable integrations.
•	Test and validate agent-driven processes end to end, confirming they behave correctly, safely and predictably in production.
•	Work with the teams responsible for agent design and knowledge management to turn intended behaviour into working platform capability.

Salesforce Platform Development
•	Design, develop and implement Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows and declarative platform capabilities.
•	Build and optimise data models, validation rules, automation, reports and dashboards.
•	Develop and extend Service Cloud capability – case management, queues, routing, entitlements, SLAs and omni-channel engagement – which is the operational backbone our agents work within.
•	Perform code reviews, unit testing, deployment and release management activities.
•	Troubleshoot application issues and deliver ongoing support, maintenance and enhancements.

Integration & Data
•	Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST and SOAP APIs.
•	Connect Salesforce to Keyloop’s broader technology stack, including internal DMS data and the Fusion platform.
•	Ensure reliable data synchronisation, sound error handling, and maintainable integration patterns.

Service & Process Efficiency
•	Identify where agents and automation can improve CE processes – from first-contact resolution and case routing to proactive customer communication and self-service deflection.
•	Partner with the business to deliver solutions that reduce cost-to-serve while lifting customer satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, Administrators and engineering teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
•	Engage the heads of function across CE (Support, Retention, Operations, Knowledge & Education) to align development priorities with business goals.
•	Liaise with Keyloop’s wider Product, Engineering and AI Centre of Excellence teams to keep CE developments coherent with platform-wide strategy.
•	Communicate build progress and outcomes clearly to non-technical stakeholders, translating technical capability into business value.

Quality, Governance & Documentation
•	Ensure solutions follow Salesforce best practices, security standards, coding standards and governance processes.
•	Apply rigorous testing and monitoring so that solutions perform accurately, safely and consistently at scale.
•	Maintain clear technical documentation, integration specifications, release notes and operational runbooks to support team scalability and knowledge transfer.
•	Stay current with Salesforce platform releases and evolving best practice.

company_profile:
Công ty Cổ phần Giải pháp Giáo dục số Geleximco (GES) là đơn vị thành viên trực thuộc Tập đoàn Geleximco – một trong những tập đoàn kinh tế đa ngành hàng đầu tại Việt Nam.
Với định hướng chiến lược tiên phong trong chuyển đổi số giáo dục, GES tập trung nghiên cứu, phát triển và triển khai hệ sinh thái giáo dục số, giáo dục STEM, các nền tảng công nghệ và ứng dụng Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) tiên tiến phục vụ nhà trường, giáo viên và học sinh trên toàn quốc.
Kế thừa nguồn lực tài chính vững mạnh cùng nền tảng văn hóa bền vững từ Tập đoàn Geleximco, GES mang đến môi trường làm việc chuyên nghiệp, sáng tạo, năng động – nơi mỗi nhân sự đều được khuyến khích phát triển toàn diện và đóng góp trực tiếp vào sự nghiệp đổi mới giáo dục thời đại số.
applicant_count: Be one of the first 20 applicants
job_description:
GES phát triển các sản phẩm học tập ứng dụng AI dành cho học sinh và giáo viên, cùng nền tảng dữ liệu giáo dục và hạ tầng AI tự vận hành.
Quản lý dự án chịu trách nhiệm bảo đảm các sản phẩm của Khối công nghệ được triển khai đúng tiến độ, đúng chất lượng yêu cầu. Vị trí này chuyển lộ trình đã được phê duyệt thành kế hoạch khả thi, điều phối các nhóm chuyên môn, duy trì thông tin rõ ràng về tiến độ và rủi ro, đồng thời giúp Ban lãnh đạo đưa ra quyết định kịp thời.
1. Lập kế hoạch và quản lý tiến độ. Chuyển lộ trình đã được phê duyệt thành kế hoạch quý, chu kỳ triển khai, sprint và đợt phát hành với người phụ trách, mối phụ thuộc và tiêu chí hoàn thành rõ ràng. Quản lý phạm vi, tiến độ, nguồn lực và chất lượng theo kế hoạch. Duy trì kế hoạch tổng thể khi nhiều sản phẩm dùng chung một giai đoạn phát hành.
2. Điều phối liên chức năng. Điều phối các nhóm Sản phẩm, BA, AI, Kỹ thuật phần mềm, Mobile, UI/UX, QA/QC và DevOps trong suốt quá trình triển khai. Thiết lập cơ chế quyết định, thời hạn xử lý và quy trình leo thang (escalation) khi phát sinh nghẽn tiến độ. Tổ chức các hoạt động lập kế hoạch, làm rõ yêu cầu, rà soát và sẵn sàng phát hành phù hợp với nhu cầu của từng sản phẩm.
3. Quản lý chất lượng và phát hành. Phối hợp với BA để hoàn thiện yêu cầu và tiêu chí nghiệm thu trước khi cam kết sprint; phối hợp với trưởng nhóm kỹ thuật để đánh giá tính khả thi và ước lượng. Thống nhất với QA/QC các điều kiện hoàn thành về chức năng, hiệu năng, trải nghiệm người dùng và chất lượng đầu ra AI. Điều phối danh sách kiểm tra trước khi phát hành, kịch bản khôi phục khi có sự cố, thông báo thay đổi và xác nhận sau triển khai.
4. Quản lý rủi ro và mối phụ thuộc. Duy trì danh mục rủi ro và vấn đề đang được theo dõi (tiến độ, nhân sự, kỹ thuật, mô hình AI, dữ liệu, hạ tầng, đối tác và tuân thủ). Mỗi hạng mục phải có đánh giá tác động, người phụ trách, biện pháp xử lý và thời hạn; theo dõi đến khi hoàn tất hoặc được chấp thuận chính thức. Cảnh báo sớm các rủi ro có thể ảnh hưởng đến mốc quan trọng, ngân sách, cam kết với đối tác hoặc uy tín sản phẩm.
5. Dữ liệu và báo cáo tiến độ. Đảm bảo kế hoạch và bảng theo dõi tiến độ luôn chính xác, được cập nhật kịp thời, và là nguồn thông tin chính thức về backlog, sprint, trạng thái công việc, người phụ trách và các mốc dự án. Báo cáo hằng tuần cho Giám đốc Công nghệ. Báo cáo định kỳ hai tuần một lần hoặc theo mốc cho Tổng Giám đốc và Ban Lãnh đạo về tiến độ, chất lượng, nguồn lực, rủi ro và các vấn đề cần xin quyết định. Phân tích dữ liệu công việc và merge request trên GitLab để theo dõi khối lượng hoàn thành, lead time, tỷ lệ mở lại và độ chính xác của dự báo tiến độ. Diễn giải các chỉ số trong đúng bối cảnh dự án, không đánh giá chỉ dựa trên con số.
6. Tối ưu quy trình & Công cụ quản lý: Chuẩn hóa quy trình vận hành và đề xuất cải tiến các công cụ báo cáo, tự động hóa tiến độ công việc của Khối Công nghệ. Phối hợp với các đội nhóm chuyên môn trong việc ứng dụng công cụ nội bộ (như bot thông báo, AI assistant) nhằm nâng cao hiệu suất làm việc.
7. Phụ trách công việc theo sự chỉ đạo của cấp trên.
job_requirements:
- Tối thiểu 03 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý dự án hoặc quản lý triển khai sản phẩm phần mềm, trong đó có ít nhất 02 năm làm việc với nhiều nhóm hoặc nhiều bên liên quan.
- Có kinh nghiệm tham gia trọn vẹn vòng đời sản phẩm số từ giai đoạn lập kế hoạch đến phát triển, kiểm thử, phát hành và vận hành.
- Có kinh nghiệm thực tế với Agile hoặc Scrum, quản lý phát hành và quản lý rủi ro, vấn đề và mối phụ thuộc trong môi trường phát triển sản phẩm.
- Hiểu biết kỹ thuật cơ bản để làm việc hiệu quả với AI Engineer, Software Engineer, DevOps về API, Dữ liệu, CI/CD, Observability và rủi ro mô hình AI. Vị trí không yêu cầu viết mã, nhưng cần có khả năng phản biện giả định và thẩm định mức độ hợp lý của ước lượng.
- Nắm vững quản lý phạm vi, tiến độ, nguồn lực, chất lượng, rủi ro và các bên liên quan; có khả năng xây dựng WBS, lộ trình, kế hoạch phát hành và báo cáo điều hành ngắn gọn, rõ ràng.
- Sử dụng tốt các công cụ quản lý công việc và tài liệu như Plane hoặc Jira, GitLab, Outline hoặc Confluence; có khả năng xây dựng quy trình báo cáo phù hợp với nhu cầu thực tế.
- Giao tiếp tốt; có khả năng đọc tài liệu kỹ thuật bằng tiếng Anh
- Trung thực, minh bạch về rủi ro và sai lệch tiến độ; chủ động báo cáo vấn đề sớm và phản ánh đúng trạng thái dự án.
- Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm trong AI/ML, EdTech, SaaS, nền tảng dữ liệu hoặc sản phẩm di động; triển khai qua đối tác phân phối lớn; hoặc có chứng chỉ PMP, PMI-ACP hay Scrum.

job_title: Power Platform Development Specialist (External Contract 12 Months)
applicant_count: Be one of the first 20 applicants
job_description:
This is a fixed-term external assignment focused on the technical design, development, maintenance and controlled enhancement of the Company’s Microsoft Power Platform solutions, particularly local e-Office applications, Power Apps and Power Automate flows. Based on requirements, business rules and acceptance criteria prepared by the internal IT team, the Specialist will analyse technical feasibility, implement maintainable solutions, troubleshoot complex defects, support controlled testing and deployment, and provide complete technical documentation and knowledge transfer. The role does not include people management, business-process ownership, direct Global IT coordination, EDI, or logistics/freight application ownership.

Note: This is a 12-month contract position. The employment contract will be signed with the Company's authorized third-party service provider.

- Develop, maintain, modify and troubleshoot assigned Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps Canvas applications, Power Automate cloud flows and, where assigned, Power Automate Desktop automations.
- Maintain and enhance current local e-Office applications and related automation flows, focusing on operational stability, data integrity, performance, security and maintainability.
- Deliver approved automation requests and development backlog based on functional requirements, business rules, test scenarios and acceptance criteria prepared by internal BA/window contacts.
- Analyse technical feasibility and propose suitable solution designs, data models and integration approaches without taking ownership of business prioritization or process decisions.
- Design and maintain approved data structures using SharePoint Online/Lists, Dataverse, SQL Server or other approved data sources, with appropriate validation, permissions, indexing and data-quality controls.
- Develop and support integrations using standard connectors, REST APIs, JSON, web services, custom connectors, on-premises data gateways and approved service accounts.
- Investigate complex production incidents by reviewing application logic, data, flow run history, logs, permissions, connections, gateway status and dependent services; identify root causes and implement controlled fixes.
- Implement appropriate error handling, logging, monitoring, notifications, retry/recovery controls and duplicate-prevention mechanisms.
- Apply Power Platform application lifecycle management practices, including Solutions, environment variables, connection references, version control, DEV/UAT/PROD deployment, release notes, rollback packages and post-deployment verification.
- Perform unit and technical testing, resolve defects from functional testing and UAT, and support production deployment under approved change and release controls.
- Maintain all source materials, solution packages, scripts, configurations and documentation in Company-approved repositories; do not retain exclusive copies or use personal ownership for production solutions.
- Prepare and maintain technical designs, data models, deployment instructions, support runbooks, known-issue records and recovery procedures sufficient for internal maintenance.
- Provide structured knowledge transfer, paired development, code/solution walkthroughs and practical coaching to assigned internal IT staff; support reverse-shadowing and capability verification.
- Support technical assessment, documentation, stabilization, migration preparation or controlled retirement of local e-Office solutions when required.
- Provide realistic effort estimates, progress updates, dependency/risk reporting and early escalation of issues affecting delivery, quality or security.
- Perform other technical development and knowledge-transfer duties reasonably related to the assignment scope, as approved by the IT Manager.
job_requirements:
► Education and Experience
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems or a related field.
- At least 4 years of professional application/software development experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on Microsoft Power Platform development and production maintenance.
- Demonstrable experience developing and supporting business-critical Power Apps and Power Automate solutions with non-trivial logic, data models, integrations and security requirements.
- Experience maintaining applications created by other developers, enterprise application support, controlled deployment and knowledge transfer.
- Strong hands-on capability in Power Apps Canvas, Power Fx and Power Automate cloud flows.
- Strong knowledge of SharePoint Online/Lists and working knowledge of Dataverse and SQL Server, including relational data, queries, validation and permissions.
- Ability to design and troubleshoot REST APIs, JSON, connectors, custom connectors, gateways and service accounts.
- Practical Power Platform ALM experience using Solutions, environment variables, connection references and controlled deployment across environments.
- Strong debugging, performance tuning, error handling, logging and production-incident resolution skills.
- Ability to produce clear technical designs, source documentation, deployment instructions and maintainable solutions.
- Power Automate Desktop, AI Builder, Power BI, model-driven apps, Dataverse security, Git/Azure DevOps, JavaScript, C#, PowerShell or Azure Functions.
- Experience with approval workflows, e-Office, internal request systems, document processes or enterprise automation; relevant Microsoft certification such as PL-400 or PL-600 is advantageous.

► Required Skills/Abilities:
- Strong analytical thinking, ownership, technical problem-solving, and ability to work independently within an agreed scope.
- Good written English for technical documentation and workable spoken English for internal IT collaboration.
- Clear communication, disciplined documentation, knowledge-sharing attitude, realistic planning and early risk escalation.

job_description:
The Opportunity
Keyloop is in the middle of an AI-enabled transformation, driven by the AI Empowered Programme — a board-mandated effort to lift AI maturity across our ~80 Product & Engineering teams. Two teams sit at the heart of it: Keystone, which builds the underlying AI capability and technical pathways, and Impost, which enables teams to adopt that capability hands-on.
We're looking for an highly motivated AI Enablement Engineer to join Impost and help our engineering teams put Keystone's AI capability to real, effective use. The primary mode of engagement is through a team's AI Champion — coaching, mentoring, or pairing with them to drive sustained, long-term change. You'll also work directly with teams for shorter periods to help resolve specific technical challenges, or gain the kind of deep, first-hand insight that's only visible from inside a team's day-to-day work and feeding it back into the programme.

This is a hands-on software engineering role, not an "engineer who used to code." You'll sit on the frontline of AI-driven development lifecycle innovation at Keyloop — as part of the Impost team, you'll be the first adopter team for Keystone's experimental new solutions, taking ownership of real internal systems as genuine test grounds. You'll contribute directly to Keystone's solutions — sometimes through early feedback on what's rough or missing, sometimes through hands-on contribution and pull requests.

Keyloop itself is a dual-speed technology organization: a large, successful DMS heritage business running on established platforms built up over decades, alongside Fusion — a modern, cloud-native Automotive Retail Platform built on AWS, event-driven domain services. You won't need to master every technology across that estate yourself — each team owns its own stack, and that expertise stays with them. Your focus is AI: helping teams leverage Claude Code, skills, agents, and Keystone's recommended solutions effectively, whatever stack they happen to be working in.

What You'll Do
•	Direct & Champion-Mediated Enablement: Provide hands-on technical support, training, and mentoring on Keystone's AI capability — working directly with a team or through its AI Champion, depending on context and champion maturity.
•	Champion Development: Build the technical capability of AI Champions so they can scale enablement within their own teams, multiplying Impost's reach beyond what a small central team could do alone.
•	Early Adoption ("Dogfooding"): Take ownership of real internal systems — starting with the OEM TTV Dashboard — as the test ground for Keystone's experimental new solutions before they reach any other team. Build with them, break them, and feed what you learn directly back into Keystone's own development, through early feedback or, where appropriate, hands-on contribution and pull requests.
•	Field Feedback & Cross-Pollination: Surface what works and what doesn't from real engagements; escalate unresolved technical friction to Keystone; spot effective practices in one team and help spread them to others.
•	Triage: Recognise when a team's blocker isn't a technical/AI problem, and surface it to the Enablement Workstream for routing — rather than trying to solve it yourself.
•	Community & Advocacy: Stay active in relevant AI communities of practice and forums as a natural part of the job; contribute technical content, demos, or talks as capacity allows.
•	AI Landscape & Continuous Learning
Proactively track developments in AI tooling and practices internally and externally. Bring relevant insights into the organisation and translate them into actionable enablement opportunities before they are asked for.

•	Fluency in AI assisted and agentic software development
•	Strong, hands-on engineering background with genuine credibility pairing and mentoring other engineers on real technical problems.

•	A genuine interest in, and demonstrated ability to have a strong positive impact on the growth of others — through pairing, mentoring, coaching, or developer advocacy. This role is built around lifting other people up, not working heads-down in isolation; if that's not energizing to you, this isn't the right fit.
•	Ability to read a team's context and choose the right mode of engagement (direct vs. through a Champion) rather than applying one approach everywhere.
•	Experience working effectively across a distributed, multi-location engineering organisation.
•	Based in, or willing to work from, Oulu, Finland or Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with a hybrid working arrangement available.

You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.
•	Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. You will combine hands-on security testing with vulnerability research, security automation, and secure development guidance.

Key Responsibilities:
- Conduct manual and automated security assessments of web applications and APIs, following OWASP methodologies and industry standards.
- Perform penetration testing on enterprise web-based systems and identify vulnerabilities through both automated tools and manual techniques.

- Work with software engineers and development teams to provide recommendations on secure coding and vulnerability remediation.

- Conduct security assessments of cloud-based environments, particularly AWS and GCP.

- Prepare clear and detailed technical reports covering vulnerabilities, risk levels, evidence, impact, and remediation recommendations.

- Practical experience using and reviewing results from SAST, DAST, and SCA tools.
- Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and create PoCs/exploits, with experience handling CVE-level vulnerabilities.
- Understanding of common security technologies such as Firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS, and EDR.
- Good understanding of core IT infrastructure, including networking, web/application servers, databases, and operating systems.
- Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language such as Python, Go, or Bash.
- Hands-on experience with mobile application security testing on Android and/or iOS.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical documentation, and communication skills.
- Sufficient English proficiency to communicate and collaborate effectively with international technical teams.
- Security certifications such as OSCP or CEH are highly valued.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Track record of achievement in CTF competitions or other recognized security challenges.
- Experience discovering previously unknown vulnerabilities and supporting CVE disclosure/assignment processes.
- Practical experience assessing security in AWS, GCP, or other cloud environments.
- Familiarity with DevSecOps, CI/CD security controls, and security automation.
- Experience with threat modeling, security architecture, or secure design reviews.
- Strong interest in vulnerability research and keeping up to date with emerging security threats and attack techniques.

job_description:
About Us
At Pixelz, we're redefining how fashion content is created. By combining cutting-edge AI technology with human creativity and expertise, we help leading fashion brands transform creative ideas into high-quality, brand-ready visual content, from e-commerce product imagery to global campaign assets.

Our platform enables brands to create content faster, scale production more efficiently, and explore new creative possibilities without the limitations of traditional photoshoots. As AI continues to reshape the fashion industry, we're building the future of digital content production, where technology empowers creativity, not replaces it.

Job Purpose
The Project Manager is a critical role at Pixelz, responsible for leading, coordinating, and mobilizing resources to drive our major projects to success. Currently, Pixelz is executing several high-impact initiatives, such as launching our new AI Studio product and onboarding major global clients. We require an outstanding, professional Project Manager who will ensure all projects are run exceptionally, delivered on time, and reach the finishing line successfully.

Key Responsibilities
Stakeholder Communication & Alignment
● Act as the primary point of contact for project communication, collaborating closely with customers, Customer Success Managers (CSM), production, operations, and other relevant departments.
● Ensure all client-facing and internal stakeholders are perfectly aligned; maintain ultimate transparency so stakeholders are never surprised by status updates.
● Communicate with a straightforward, clear, and professional style.
● Demonstrate strong assertiveness and pushing-back skills to align expectations when project timelines or scopes are unrealistic, even with senior stakeholders.

Resource, Capacity Coordination & Problem Solving
● Lead and coordinate resources and capacities across multiple locations to ensure seamless project delivery.
● Act as a dynamic problem solver; resolve complex issues and provide effective guidance and coaching to the team.
● Maintain a calm demeanor under high pressure while executing rapid and precise solutions.

Project Planning & Governance
● Take full charge of creating key project documents, including detailed project plans, roadmaps, and project charters from Day 1.
● Establish and enforce project governance processes, ensuring standard practices are followed across all departments.

Risk & Issue Management
● Proactively anticipate, identify, and manage potential risks before they are raised or escalate into critical issues.
● Identify, address, and communicate delivery risks early, establishing clear and effective recovery plans for any timeline or budget deviations.

Reporting & Documentation
● Produce highly structured, clear, and clean project reports and post-project reviews for leadership.
● Maintain meticulous project documentation so that any external team member can easily pick up and understand the project mid-stream.
job_requirements:
Must-Have Qualifications
● PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification is mandatory.
● Fluent Professional English (C1 level or above), both written and verbal, is mandatory.

Experience
● 5+ years of proven experience in successfully delivering complex, high-impact projects involving a large number of stakeholders across multiple locations.
● Prior experience managing client-facing projects in a multi-language, cross-cultural environment.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
● Exceptional project planning, scheduling, and resource coordination skills.
● Outstanding analytical, logical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
● High level of comfort working cross-culturally and with diverse teams.

Mindset & Behaviors
● Strong Ownership: Treats project outcomes as their own personal accountability, going beyond a mere tracking function.
● Calm under high pressure but exceptionally quick in taking action.
● Assertive, honest, trustworthy, and a strong team player.

Definition of Success
● Accelerated Onboarding & Contribution: Successfully drive self-led onboarding from day one, demonstrating the ability to take immediate ownership of complex, high-impact projects.
● On-time Delivery: Consistently meet all critical project milestones and deliverables on schedule, ensuring that timelines are strictly adhered to.
● Operational & Financial Impact: Achieve defined project goals, ensuring that all outcomes align with both operational efficiency targets and financial expectations.
● Rigorous Project Governance: Establish, maintain, and enforce best-in-class governance processes, ensuring standard practices are consistently followed across all departments.
● Meticulous Documentation: Maintain transparent and high-quality project documentation that allows any external stakeholder or team member to easily understand and pick up the project at any stage.
● Long-term Strategic Execution: Successfully drive big, complex initiatives to completion, ensuring seamless alignment across cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

What We Offer
● Flexible working hours in a results-oriented culture with 5 days working from home per month.
● Attractive salary reflecting your impact on business and quality outcomes.
● Full statutory insurance plus enhanced private healthcare (Pixelz Care), along with annual health check-ups and wellbeing programs.
● Work in a truly international environment, collaborating with teams across Europe, the US, and Asia.
● Clear development pathways, hands-on training, and opportunities to build new capabilities in AI-driven production.
● Up to 15 days annual leave, summer day off, and full maternity (6 months) & paternity (2 weeks) leave.
● Team building activities, company trips, clubs (sports, chess, etc.), Happy Friday events, and a collaborative, energetic workplace.

company_profile:
Masan MEATLife (MML) là doanh nghiệp hàng đầu Việt Nam áp dụng nền tảng 3F “từ trang trại đến bàn ăn” với chuỗi giá trị tích hợp, nhằm cung cấp các sản phẩm thịt có thương hiệu, đảm bảo vệ sinh, truy xuất được nguồn gốc và giá cả hợp lý.
Với tầm nhìn trở thành công ty hàng đầu dẫn dắt ngành thịt Việt Nam, MML đã chọn điểm khởi đầu trong chuỗi cung ứng thịt là thức ăn chăn nuôi bằng việc hợp nhất hai công ty thức ăn chăn nuôi hàng đầu tại Việt Nam là ANCO và Proconco vào năm 2015, và ra mắt sản phẩm “Bio-zeem” – thương hiệu dẫn đầu về hiệu suất. Công ty đã quyết liệt đầu tư vào phần còn lại của chuỗi cung ứng - trang trại, nhà máy chế biến, chuỗi bán lẻ - trong 2 năm 2017, 2018 để ra mắt người tiêu dùng thương hiệu thịt mát MEATDeli vào cuối năm 2018. Thịt mát MEATDeli là thương hiệu đầu tiên tại Việt Nam được sản xuất theo công nghệ chế biến tiêu chuẩn châu Âu

job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

- Software Engineering & Hands-on Solution Delivery (≈30%)
• Stay hands-on: personally design, write, review and refactor production-quality code across CLD VN’s AI, automation and digital initiatives.
• Rapidly prototype, test and ship working solutions to address real business pain points, and unblock the team on complex technical problems.
• Establish and model baseline engineering practices - version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD and secure development lifecycle - starting lean and maturing over time.
• Own the definition of done and the quality gates that keep CLD VN’s codebase maintainable, secure and production-ready as it scales.

- Enterprise Platform, Integration & IT Delivery (≈25%)
• Lead end-to-end delivery of enterprise digital and IT projects - from requirement scoping through build, integration, testing, deployment, operation and iteration.
• Design, build and operate the integration layer connecting AI tools, enterprise systems, data sources and internal workflows.
• Build dashboards, analytics tools and process automation using Python, modern web stacks, Microsoft Power Platform and cloud-based AI services, with production-grade engineering rigour.
• Own the execution environment, operations architecture and DevOps practices across projects, including reliability, observability and cost efficiency.

- AI, Automation & Data Products (≈20%)
• Lead end-to-end delivery of AI, automation and data/digital products, from scoping and solution design to deployment, adoption and iteration.
• Develop and integrate AI-enabled solutions (e.g., Copilot Studio agents, LLM APIs, document intelligence) for internal business use cases.
• Build and maintain data pipelines and foundational data structures to support analytics, reporting and AI use cases.
• In the interim, cover data engineering foundations.

- Technical Leadership, Architecture & Governance (≈15%)
• Own solution architecture across AI and digital initiatives, ensuring alignment with CLD’s AI and digital strategy and enterprise best practices.
• Evaluate and select tools, platforms and APIs, and make defensible, commercially grounded build-vs-buy-vs-leverage recommendations.
• Review and enforce technical standards, integration patterns and data governance.
• Prepare technical inputs for management - architecture updates, solution assessments, risk considerations and progress.
• Align CLD VN practices to IT policies and determine the best-fit local implementation; support audits of applications and systems supporting CLD VN requirements.

- Tech Liaison & Citizen Developer Enablement (≈10%)
• Serve as CLD VN’s primary technical point of contact with the Digital & Technology Team, navigating shared data infrastructure, system access and cross-entity governance protocols.
• Coordinate API integrations, data pipeline access and system onboarding; represent CLD VN’s technical requirements in cross-entity forums.
• Enable the citizen developer / AI builder community by defining safe, reusable patterns, paved-road templates and governance guardrails for low-code builders.
• Provide engineering support, mentoring and technical guidance to AI builders and future team members as the AI & Digital team scales.
job_requirements:
REQUIREMENTS:

- Education & Expertise
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related fields.
• 5 - 7+ years’ experience in technology roles, with at least 1 - 2 years in a senior, lead or architectural capacity (5+ years preferred).
• Proven track record delivering enterprise IT projects and platforms end to end, across cloud platforms, APIs and data infrastructure.
• Experience leading technical delivery as a tech lead, engineering lead, product or project lead; background in technology consulting or enterprise digital transformation is an advantage.

- Technical Skills
o Required:
▪ Strong, demonstrable hands-on software engineering experience - able to ship and maintain production systems and still write code today (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, modern web frameworks, SQL).
▪ Solid command of software engineering best practice - version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD and secure SDLC.
▪ Hands-on experience with cloud-native services, APIs and system integration.
▪ Working experience with the Microsoft ecosystem - Microsoft 365, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and Power BI.
o Nice to Have:
▪ Experience with enterprise AI/ML platforms, LLM APIs, Copilot Studio or Azure AI Foundry.
▪ Experience across data analytics and data engineering - building data pipelines, data models and analytics products.
▪ Hands-on experience with Azure, Databricks and Microsoft Fabric.
▪ Knowledge of enterprise data governance - data classification, access control and compliance frameworks.
▪ Familiarity with real estate, property development, asset management or financial services business models.

- Business Acumen
• Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into actionable technical briefs and practical digital solutions.
• Strong business communication skills; able to brief senior, non-technical stakeholders clearly and concisely in plain language.
• Able to connect technical decisions with business outcomes such as productivity gains, efficiency, risk reduction and cost optimisation.

- Mindset & Soft Skills
• Comfortable being a team of one initially - a pragmatic, hands-on builder who will grow into a technical leader and mentor as the AI & Digital team scales.
• Strong organisational and planning skills to manage multiple initiatives in parallel in a lean, evolving team.
• Growth mindset and willingness to continuously learn and upskill in engineering, cloud, automation and AI topics.
• Acts as a change agent in a traditional environment, patient and persistent in driving technology adoption.
• Strong collaboration and facilitation skills to work across business, IT and cross-entity stakeholders.

job_description:
1. Xây dựng và vận hành năng lực kiểm thử tự động hóa – liên tục
•	Triển khai, vận hành nền tảng và bộ công cụ kiểm thử (Burp Suite Professional/Enterprise, ZAP, Nuclei, SAST/DAST/SCA/IAST).
•	Tích hợp kiểm thử bảo mật vào CI/CD pipeline (shift-left), quản lý SBOM và rủi ro chuỗi cung ứng phần mềm.
•	Nghiên cứu CVE mới, viết PoC/mã khai thác, phát triển công cụ nội bộ (Python/Go) và tự động hóa quy trình kiểm thử.
•	Ứng dụng AI/LLM để tăng tốc phân tích và soạn báo cáo, đồng thời kiểm soát rủi ro rò rỉ dữ liệu khi sử dụng AI.
•	Tư vấn cấp trên về công nghệ, giải pháp an toàn ứng dụng mới cho các đơn vị trong hệ sinh thái.

2. Kiểm thử xâm nhập ứng dụng Web, API và ứng dụng tích hợp AI
•	Kiểm thử thủ công chuyên sâu theo OWASP WSTG/ASVS: lỗi logic nghiệp vụ, IDOR/BOLA, race condition, SSRF, deserialization, HTTP request smuggling, tấn công phía client.
•	Kiểm thử API (REST/GraphQL/gRPC/Webhook) theo OWASP API Security Top 10; kiểm thử phân quyền, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SAML, JWT, SSO và luồng xác thực không mật khẩu (passkey).
•	Kiểm thử ứng dụng tích hợp AI/LLM và Agentic AI: prompt injection, rò rỉ dữ liệu qua RAG, lạm dụng quyền của agent/tool, kiểm soát kết nối MCP.
•	Cung cấp bằng chứng khai thác (PoC), xếp hạng rủi ro theo CVSS 4.0 gắn với tác động nghiệp vụ; thực hiện retest xác nhận khắc phục (Remediation Verification).
•	Phối hợp các bộ phận liên quan xây dựng phương án vá lỗi và tái đánh giá.

3. Hỗ trợ Blue Team/SOC nâng cao năng lực phòng thủ (Purple Team)
•	Chuyển kịch bản tấn công thành detection use case theo MITRE ATT&CK đo lường khả năng phát hiện và phản ứng.
•	Tư vấn kiến trúc phòng thủ ứng dụng: WAF/WAAP, API Gateway, chống bot và lạm dụng API, nguyên tắc Zero Trust.

Position Summary
Head of Technology is the most senior technology leadership role within MiTek Vietnam and serves as a strategic extension of MiTek's Global Technology organization.

This executive role is responsible for defining and executing the technology vision, strategy, and operating model for one of the world's leading services businesses, ensuring technology is a key enabler of business growth, customer success, operational excellence, and innovation.

The position provides enterprise-wide leadership across key technology functions, including IT Operations, Technology Solutions, Digital Platforms, Business Analytics, Data & AI, Enterprise Technology Administration, Project Delivery, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Technology Governance. The role has direct leadership responsibility for the Vietnam IT Operations Team, Technology Development Team, Business Analytics Team, Technical Administration (ServiceNow Support) Team, and Project Delivery Team, ensuring these functions operate as an integrated technology organization aligned with both global technology strategy and regional business priorities.

Working closely with Global Technology leadership and the Vietnam Executive Leadership Team, Head of Technology is accountable for translating global technology strategy into effective execution within Vietnam. The role drives digital transformation, accelerates AI adoption, strengthens technology capabilities, and delivers scalable solutions that enhance operational performance, customer value, and enterprise outcomes.

The successful candidate will build and lead a high-performing technology organization, foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement, and ensure the delivery of technology services, platforms, and solutions that support MiTek's long-term strategic objectives and global technology priorities.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop and execute MiTek Vietnam's technology strategy in alignment with global technology and business objectives.
• Provide executive leadership and strategic direction across the Vietnam IT Operations, Technology Development, Business Analytics, Technical Administration (ServiceNow Support), and Project Delivery teams.
• Serve as the principal technology advisor to the Vietnam Executive Leadership Team and a key partner to Global Technology leadership.
• Lead enterprise-wide digital transformation, modernization, automation, and AI initiatives to improve business performance, scalability, and customer outcomes.
• Oversee the design, implementation, delivery, and support of technology solutions, digital platforms, and enterprise technology services.
• Drive the development of data, analytics, and AI capabilities that enable informed decision-making and support business growth.
• Ensure the successful delivery of strategic technology programs and projects through effective portfolio, governance, and resource management.
• Establish and maintain technology governance, cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and operational excellence frameworks.
• Build, mentor, and develop senior technology leaders while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Partner with business leaders and global stakeholders to identify technology opportunities, prioritize investments, and maximize business value.
• Drive technology excellence, service reliability, technology standardization, and continuous operational improvement across all technology functions.
• Advance MiTek's global technology, digital, and AI agendas while ensuring regional execution supports long-term business growth and competitive advantage.

Success Profile
The ideal candidate is a transformational technology executive with a proven track record leading complex technology organizations across technology delivery, IT operations, business analytics, project delivery, enterprise platforms, and technology services.
They possess the strategic vision, leadership capability, and commercial acumen required to align technology investments with business objectives, build world-class technology teams, and position technology as a key driver of innovation, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.

root/jailbreak, SSL pinning, chống can thiệp (anti-tampering/RASP) để đánh giá thực chất
khả năng chống chịu của ứng dụng.
• Đánh giá an toàn cho các luồng nghiệp vụ trọng yếu trên di động: thanh toán, eKYC/xác
thực sinh trắc học, chữ ký số, tokenization và lưu trữ dữ liệu nhạy cảm trên thiết bị.
• Khai thác và chứng minh lỗ hổng bằng PoC có kiểm soát; xếp hạng rủi ro theo tác động
nghiệp vụ và thực hiện retest xác nhận khắc phục.
• Nghiên cứu kỹ thuật tấn công và mã độc di động mới; phát triển công cụ, script tự động
hóa phục vụ kiểm thử liên tục và tích hợp vào quy trình phát hành ứng dụng.
• Tư vấn kỹ thuật cho đội phát triển di động về nguyên nhân gốc và giải pháp khắc phục; hỗ
trợ Blue Team/SOC xây dựng năng lực phát hiện tấn công nhắm vào người dùng di động.

II. Mô tả công việc/ Job Descriptions:
1. Kiểm thử xâm nhập ứng dụng di động Android và iOS
• Thực hiện kiểm thử theo chuẩn OWASP MASVS/MASTG trên cả hai nền tảng: phân tích tĩnh (jadx, apktool, Ghidra/IDA, MobSF) và phân tích động (Frida, objection, r2frida, Burp Suite).
• Kiểm thử lưu trữ dữ liệu trên thiết bị: Keychain/Keystore, cơ sở dữ liệu cục bộ, tệp cache, log, sao lưu, dữ liệu tồn dư trong bộ nhớ và ảnh chụp màn hình nền.
• Kiểm thử cơ chế mật mã: thuật toán yếu, khóa cứng trong mã nguồn, sinh khóa không an toàn, sử dụng sai IV/salt, quản lý vòng đời khóa.
• Kiểm thử giao tiếp liên tiến trình và bề mặt tấn công của nền tảng: deep link/App Link/Universal Link, intent redirection, component bị export, custom URL scheme, lỗ hỏng WebView và JavaScript bridge.
• Đánh giá cơ chế bảo vệ ứng dụng: phát hiện root/jailbreak, SSL pinning, chống debug, làm rối mã, RASP, Play Integrity API và App Attest – xác định khả năng vượt qua trên thực tế.
2. Kiểm thử API backend và các luồng nghiệp vụ trọng yếu
• Kiểm thử API phục vụ ứng dụng di động theo OWASP API Security Top 10: BOLA/IDOR, lỗi phân quyền, lạm dụng hạn mức, lộ dữ liệu quá mức.
• Kiểm thử xác thực và quản lý phiên: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, refresh token, device binding, xác thực sinh trắc học (BiometricPrompt/Face ID) và khả năng vượt qua ở lớp client.
• Kiểm thử luồng thanh toán và định danh: tokenization, HCE/NFC, giao dịch trực tuyến, eKYC – bao gồm thử nghiệm vượt kiểm tra liveness bằng ảnh, video và nội dung tổng hợp bằng AI (deepfake).
• Kiểm thử lỗi logic nghiệp vụ đặc thù di động: race condition khi giao dịch, thao túng tham số phía client, phát lại yêu cầu (replay), lạm dụng luồng khôi phục tài khoản.
3. Đánh giá rủi ro nền tảng, SDK bên thứ ba và quyền riêng tư
• Rà soát SDK/thư viện bên thứ ba tích hợp trong ứng dụng: lỗ hổng đã công bố, hành vi thu thập dữ liệu ngoài phạm vi công bố, rủi ro chuỗi cung ứng và quản lý SBOM cho ứng dụng di động.
• Đánh giá việc xin và sử dụng quyền (permission), rò rỉ dữ liệu cá nhân sang bên thứ ba, tính chính xác của Google Play Data Safety và Apple Privacy Manifest.
• Đối chiếu tuân thủ Luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân số 91/2025/QH15 và các quy định chuyên ngành áp dụng cho ứng dụng giao dịch điện tử.
• Đánh giá ứng dụng tích hợp AI/LLM và mô hình chạy trên thiết bị (on-device model): trích xuất mô hình, prompt injection qua dữ liệu đầu vào, rò rỉ dữ liệu qua SDK AI.
4. Nghiên cứu, phát triển công cụ và tự động hóa kiểm thử
• Theo dõi và phân tích kỹ thuật tấn công, mã độc ngân hàng trên di động (overlay, lạm dụng
Accessibility Service, đánh cắp dữ liệu sinh trắc học) và đánh giá mức độ ảnh hưởng tới ứng dụng của Tập đoàn.
• Viết PoC/mã khai thác cho lỗ hổng đã công bố và lỗ hổng tự phát hiện; nghiên cứu lỗ hổng trên framework và SDK mã nguồn mở đang sử dụng.
• Phát triển script Frida, công cụ nội bộ (Python/Bash) và mở rộng công cụ sẵn có nhằm rút ngắn thời gian kiểm thử.
• Tham gia tích hợp kiểm thử bảo mật vào pipeline CI/CD của ứng dụng di động (SAST/SCA/MobSF quét tự động trên mỗi bản build), tinh chỉnh rule để giảm cảnh báo sai.
• Quản trị, sao lưu và nâng cấp hạ tầng lab kiểm thử di động: thiết bị thật đã root/jailbreak, thiết bị giả lập và nền tảng ảo hóa.
5. Báo cáo, tư vấn khắc phục và phối hợp phòng thủ
• Soạn báo cáo kiểm thử song ngữ Việt – Anh: mô tả kỹ thuật, bằng chứng khai thác, xếp hạng theo CVSS 4.0 gắn với tác động nghiệp vụ và khuyến nghị khắc phục khả thi.
• Trình bày kết quả cho đội phát triển di động và các bên liên quan; tư vấn nguyên nhân gốc, secure coding và kiểm soát bù đắp khi chưa thể vá ngay.
• Chuyển kịch bản khai thác thành yêu cầu phát hiện cho Blue Team/SOC; hỗ trợ đánh giá hiệu quả của giải pháp bảo vệ ứng dụng di động (MTD/RASP).
• Theo dõi tiến độ khắc phục và thực hiện retest xác nhận (Remediation Verification) trước khi phát hành phiên bản mới lên App Store/Google Play.
6. Chuẩn hóa phương pháp luận và chia sẻ tri thức
• Biên soạn, rà soát định kỳ quy trình, quy định, checklist kiểm thử và mẫu báo cáo cho mảng
ứng dụng di động.
• Hướng dẫn kỹ thuật và review kết quả của chuyên viên cấp thấp hơn.
• Tổ chức chia sẻ nội bộ về kỹ thuật tấn công mới; đóng góp nội dung đào tạo secure coding
cho đội phát triển di động.
• Tham gia xử lý sự cố mức chuyên sâu và các đợt đánh giá đột xuất khi có yêu cầu.

job_description:
I. ROLE PURPOSE

We are looking for an SAP Solution Engineer/SAP Executive to take technical ownership of our SAP landscape. Today that means our SAP Business One installation: keeping it running, resolving user issues, and delivering new configuration and enhancements as the business grows. Over time it means preparing the ground for a future move to SAP S/4HANA.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You will be the person who knows how the system is actually configured, why it behaves the way it does, and what it will take to change it. You are expected to understand the business processes behind the system well enough to challenge a requirement before it gets built, not only to implement what you are handed.

Reports to: Head of Engineering

Works with: Finance, Supply Chain, Production, Retail Operations, Data & BI

II. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
System ownership and support
- Take over full working knowledge of the current SAP Business One installation — configuration, customisations, integrations, and any undocumented behaviour — and document it.
- Provide day-to-day support to SAP users across Finance, Supply Chain, Production and Retail: investigate, resolve, and root-cause issues within agreed response times.
- Distinguish user error, data error, configuration gap and genuine defect — and fix the underlying cause.
- Manage escalations to our SAP partner or vendor, and hold them accountable for resolution quality.

Implementation and enhancement
- Translate business requirements into working configuration: user-defined fields and tables, formatted searches, approval procedures, document settings, authorisations.
- Build and maintain integrations between SAP and our operational systems (POS, e-commerce, internal platforms) using the Service Layer, DI API, or middleware.
- Write and review technical specifications; brief and supervise external developers where custom development is needed.
- Own unit testing and SIT, support business users through UAT, and manage release and change control.
- Push back on customisation that standard functionality already covers, and keep a record of every customisation and why it exists.

Master data
- Own SAP master data as a system: item/material, business partner, pricing, BOM/recipe, chart of accounts, cost centres.
- Define and enforce master data standards — naming, mandatory fields, ownership, approval flow.
- Build tooling for bulk creation, mass change, and validation; run regular data quality checks and drive remediation with business owners.

Reporting
- Build and maintain operational and financial reports (Crystal Reports, SAP B1 queries, dashboards).
- Work with the Data & BI team on extraction into the central analytics platform; agree what belongs in SAP and what belongs downstream.
- Rationalise the existing report estate — retire what is unused, standardise what is duplicated.

S/4HANA readiness (ongoing, not a project)
- Maintain a current inventory of processes, customisations, integrations and master data objects so a future migration starts from facts, not archaeology.
- Keep master data clean and structured in a way that will survive a migration.
- Flag any proposed customisation that would be difficult to carry forward.
- Build your own S/4HANA capability through training and certification, supported by the company.

III. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education
Bachelor‘s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Information Systems, Accounting/Finance, or a related field.

Experience
- 1–3 years hands-on experience implementing and supporting an ERP system (SAP, or a comparable enterprise ERP).
- Experience through at least one **full implementation or major rollout** — not support tickets alone. You have seen requirements, build, testing, cutover and the aftermath.
- Working understanding of core business processes end to end: **procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report, inventory and production**. Deep enough to spot when a specification will not work before it gets built.
- **Strong SQL.** You can query, join, reconcile and investigate data independently. This is non-negotiable.
- Experience building reports for business users.
- Experience with system integration — APIs, file interfaces, or middleware.
- Structured and self-directed: able to take an undocumented system and make sense of it without being walked through it.
- Certification (mandatory): A current SAP Certified Associate qualification in S/4HANA

Language
- English — professional working proficiency.
- Vietnamese — professional working proficiency.

IV. NICE TO HAVE
- Exposure to **SAP S/4HANA or ECC** — configuration, CDS views, Fiori, or migration work.
- Experience in **F&B, retail, or manufacturing**: recipe/BOM management, production orders, multi-outlet inventory.
- ABAP debugging (reading and tracing, not writing).
- SAP certification.
- ClickUp, Jira, or similar delivery tooling.
- Experience working alongside an external implementation partner.
